texts.preamble: State Of Gujarat - Thro' R P Christian vs Chelabhai Maganbhai Patel on 4 March, 2013 Author: Harsha Devani Bench: Harsha Devani State Of Gujarat - Thro' R P Christian, Food INSPECTOR....Applicant(s)V/SCHELAB R/Cr.Ma/15621/2012 Order
texts.arguments: Mr. K. L. Pandya, learned Additional Public Prosecutor assailed the impugned judgement and order by submitting that the learned Judge has failed to appreciate the evidence in proper perspective and has erroneously come to the conclusion that the prosecution has not established the charges levelled against the accused beyond reasonable doubt. It was submitted that the prosecution has led voluminous evidence, both documentary as well as oral, against the accused and has duly established the charges levelled against them.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Mr. K. L. texts.respondent_arguments: It was submitted that the prosecution has led voluminous evidence, both documentary as well as oral, against the accused and has duly established the charges levelled against them.
